## 2. Engineering Philosophy & Tech Stack
IKASLE Technologies follows an engineering-first, product-driven methodology:
- **Frontend Architecture**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Motion / GSAP animations, Responsive Fluid Grid.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Fluid Compute.
- **Mobile Development**: React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin for iOS and Android deployment.
- **DevOps & Quality**: Automated CI/CD pipelines, Docker containerization, strict ESLint & TypeScript validation, zero-compromise security benchmarks.
- **Security & IP**: Standard Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDA), 100% IP ownership transfer upon delivery, OWASP Top 10 compliance.

## 3. Seven Core Services Breakdown

### 3.1 Custom Software Development
- **URL**: https://www.ikasletechnologies.com/services/custom-software-development
- **Scope**: Internal business tools, custom ERP modules, database architecture, workflow automation, and enterprise legacy modernization.
- **Target Audience**: Growing SMEs and mid-sized enterprises moving away from chaotic spreadsheets and off-the-shelf software limitations.

### 3.2 Website Development
- **URL**: https://www.ikasletechnologies.com/services/website-development
- **Scope**: Ultra-fast marketing websites, corporate portals, accessibility compliance (WCAG), international SEO architecture, dynamic content pipelines.
- **Key Location**: Renowned Website Development Company in Peelamedu, Coimbatore, serving domestic and international clients.

### 3.3 Web Application Development
- **URL**: https://www.ikasletechnologies.com/services/web-application-development
- **Scope**: Multi-tenant SaaS platforms, interactive client portals, high-concurrency dashboards, real-time analytics.

### 3.4 Mobile App Development
- **URL**: https://www.ikasletechnologies.com/services/mobile-app-development
- **Scope**: High-performance iOS and Android applications, offline-first synchronization, secure biometric authentication, push notifications.

### 3.5 ERP & Business Automation
- **URL**: https://www.ikasletechnologies.com/services/erp-business-automation
- **Scope**: Supply chain tracking, automated invoice generation, live stock inventory management, production floor reporting (exemplified by Kiddos Foods ERP).

### 3.6 AI & Intelligent Solutions
- **URL**: https://www.ikasletechnologies.com/services/ai-intelligent-solutions
- **Scope**: Contextual LLM wrappers, automated document ingestion, computer vision, AI-assisted customer chatbots, workflow agents.

### 3.7 UI/UX & Product Design
- **URL**: https://www.ikasletechnologies.com/services/ui-ux-product-design
- **Scope**: User research, clickable Figma prototypes, comprehensive design tokens, UX heuristics auditing, mobile-first design systems.
